description: The line plot illustrates the relationship between reliability score and cost for three different models: the 3-Model Ensemble, the 2-Model Ensemble, and GPT-4. The x-axis, labeled "Cost," ranges from 0 to 10 on a linear scale, with tick marks at intervals of 2. The y-axis, labeled "Reliability Score," ranges from 30 to 90, also on a linear scale, with visible gridlines at 50 and 80. The 3-Model Ensemble is represented by a blue line with circular markers, starting at a reliability score of approximately 88 when the cost is 0 and gradually decreasing to about 83 at a cost of 10. The 2-Model Ensemble is shown as a red line with circular markers, beginning at a reliability score of around 86 at a cost of 0 and decreasing to approximately 81 at a cost of 10. The GPT-4 model is depicted by a yellow line with circular markers, starting at a reliability score of about 89 at a cost of 0, then dropping sharply to around 62 at a cost of 5, and continuing to decline to a final score of approximately 37 at a cost of 10. All three lines show a decreasing trend in reliability score as cost increases, with the GPT-4 model exhibiting the most significant drop.
